lines.text: From the moment I read the script, I knew “Tiger 3” was going to be a special project.
‘Rocketry’ has been a special film for me, as it allowed me to explore a character with depth, vulnerability, and strength.
It’s been an incredible journey that has taught me so much about life, love, and the power of cinema.
But most importantly, I want to thank my fans for their unwavering encouragement and support of me.
